description: Gap analysis rubric question pack for Project Aegis requirements vs Linear/Notion backlogs.

thresholds.score_note: Use Score for discrete rank/threshold triage only; never treat as linear multiplier.

backlog_completeness.instructions: Given the requirement summary, acceptance criteria, and matched Linear/Notion records, is this requirement completely and traceably represented?

criteria.true: Matched records cover core scope, source citation, acceptance criteria, and cross-links.
criteria.false: Missing coverage, partial AC, or stale/unlinked backlog entry.

gap_classification.instructions: Classify the primary gap status for this requirement across Linear and Notion.

criteria.complete: Requirement is fully represented in both Linear and Notion.
criteria.incomplete: Record exists but lacks required source citation, acceptance criteria, or cross-link.
criteria.missing: No corresponding requirement record exists in the target backlog.
criteria.deferred_tracked: Explicitly deferred Phase N requirement properly tracked in Backlog under DRG-47.
criteria.other: Does not fit any listed classification.

remediation_priority.instructions: Rank the remediation urgency for this requirement gap.
criteria: low — deferred Phase N or minor metadata enrichment
medium — incomplete acceptance criteria or missing cross-link
high — missing core MVP/combat requirement from active backlog
